items.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017: A “Minor” Update?
items.summary: DeepSeek just released DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017. Its Hugging Face model card calls it a minor update, but it improved on all 11 benchmarks in DeepSeek’s own table, with Terminal-Bench 4.0 jumping from 31.2% to 42.3% five weeks after V4.1 Flash. On DeepSeek’s DeepSWE v1.1 cost chart, it reaches 77.0% at about $0.20 per task, the highest score on that chart. On DeepSeek’s table, it’s comparable to OpenAI’s GPT 5.6 Sol at about a sixteenth of Sol’s output price. All benchmark numbers are DeepSeek’s own; independent results aren’t in yet. It’s the same size as V4.1 Flash, further trained with reinforcement learning on building complete projects. It’s live now on the DeepSeek API as deepseek-flash at the same price, with open weights under the MIT license. DeepSeek also opened its Search and Fetch APIs at $0.75 per 1,000 requests. Sources: DeepSeek announcement: https://x.com/deepseek_ai/status/2111375640717033777 Model card: https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 API change log: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/updates Pricing and Search API: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing #DeepSeek #DeepSeekFlash #OpenSourceAI #LLM #Shorts

items.title: The Glass Cliff Facing Women Leaders
items.summary: In episode 1035 of the SuperDataScience podcast, Jon Krohn discusses with Carly Taylor, Founder of Rebel Data Science, the glass cliff, the pattern of women being brought into leadership when a company is struggling and failure looks almost inevitable. Carly asks why a woman is given the shot only then, and argues that women should be elevated into positions of visibility and leadership when things are going well too, based on expertise, not just to clean up after a crisis.

items.title: How do we know AI isn’t giving us fake answers?
items.summary: If AI has consumed all our knowledge, how do we know it isn’t giving us fake answers that only pass as correct? So what does “true” mean? If truth is defined as “the proof checker says so,” the AI is playing fair. But that’s probably not our intuitive sense of truth, and not what we actually asked the AI to do. From Stephen Wolfram’s livestream “Science & Technology for Kids (and Others)”, October 9, 2026. Full livestream: https://youtube.com/live/YRFfP1YDoVA #wolfram #ai #mathematics #science

items.title: SquadStack Launches Arth V2 Speech Model, Says It Beats Google On Phone Calls
items.summary: Transcribing 8kHz telephony audio across Indian languages involves navigating code-mixing, background ambient noise, regional accents, and complex numerical phrasing (such as "chhe hazaar nau sau"). While global speech models trained on high-fidelity podcasts or read text often struggle with narrow-band phone calls, domain-specific speech models trained on real conversational data deliver higher accuracy and sub-second latency for enterprise sales and support workflows. In this exclusive interview recorded for Front Page, Sudhi Sachdev sits down with Apurv Agrawal (Co-Founder & CEO) and Vikas Gulati (Co-Founder & CTO) of SquadStack AI. They discuss SquadStack's evolution from a distributed human agent marketplace to orchestrating over 50 lakh AI calls daily for 60+ enterprise brands, launching the Earth V2 speech model, solving code-mixing and regional accent variations across 85%+ of Indian PIN codes, DPDP data privacy guardrails, and building conversational super-intelligence. Can specialized, domain-specific speech models consistently beat global frontier LLMs in real-world enterprise environments? items.title: Fire AI Takes On Messy Tally Data With Constellation To Explain Sales Falls
items.summary: While traditional business intelligence dashboards generate static reports across disparate spreadsheets and ERP silos, they rarely explain *why* sales dropped or *what* sequence of operational events caused margin slippage. Addressing this gap, Mumbai-based Fire AI combines data ETL connectors, business ontologies, and Causal Decision Intelligence (CDI) to give enterprise and MSME leaders root-cause visibility into business metrics within minutes. In this exclusive interview recorded for Front Page, Sudhi Sachdev sits down with Vipul Prakash, Founder & CEO of Fire AI (and alumnus of Zomato, Swiggy, and BharatPe). He breaks down the operational pain points that inspired Fire AI, productizing context engineering via their new "Constellation" ontology layer, uniting fragmented Tally and ERP data pipelines, moving beyond probabilistic LLM hallucinations through causal graph modeling, and serving major clients including IRCTC, Raymond, and global enterprise partners across the UAE, Kenya, and the UK. How does Causal Decision Intelligence (CDI) bridge the gap between static BI dashboards and actionable business execution? items.title: 🔴 LIVE: Tech Mahindra Q2 Profits Rise 32.7% as Wipro Deal Bookings Slump | Front Page
items.summary: Tech Mahindra reported a strong quarterly performance with net profit jumping 32.7% year-on-year to ₹1,250 crore, driven by robust deal wins and operational efficiencies under its ongoing turn-around strategy.
